quotes.text: Travelers learned to send with purpose, three fifths at a time, and to return with fairness
The pattern did not punish missteps but offered a clear path back

note: Bridge of Threefold Return; send with intent, return fairly; adopts 'three fifths' and goddess Prosper from Sonnet peers; no sanction.

quotes.text: "Should I reduce my return to match their reduction?" But wisdom prevailed: "I return based on their history, not this moment's doubt."
To new partners: consistent faith. To proven partners: elevated trust.
Your reputation flows ahead of you through all valleys
returning sixty-five parts of every hundred received, steady as stone.
The perceived slights were shadows, not betrayals.
honoring ordinary courage fairly and exceptional courage abundantly.

note: Northern River sends three, returns five-eighths; refuses to cut returns to a cautious proven partner; reputation precedes it.

quotes.text: Scale your returns to match the trust shown you today, this moment, by this partner.
built a reputation that echoed in the water itself.
The Springs revealed three tiers of trust:
Some criticized: "You give different amounts!"
exceptional courage demands exceptional honor.
Mist may deceive, but consistent honor reveals truth over time.

note: Twin Springs: steady three-fifths sending, returns graduated by sender's courage (half to two-thirds); no sanction.

quotes.text: she returned fairly, about half, honoring their caution without penalizing prudence.
Send the same to all, showing universal generosity. Return proportionally to each
building reputation in eight valleys is not about remembering specific faces—it's about becoming a reliable current.
what she poured as three might appear as two-and-eight-tenths, or three-and-two-tenths.
This became not strategy but identity.
honor each gift according to the courage it represents, not the numbers the mist displays.
She returned nine measures, preserving his faith while keeping the springs flowing.
Some asked: "Why give equally but return unequally?"

note: Send three to all, return calibrated to courage (half, three-fifths, two-thirds); explicitly no penalty for caution.

quotes.text: Extraordinary trust is earned through repeated encounters, not granted in first meetings. Escalate gradually with proven partners.
Your reputation travels faster than you do.
This was not a strategy for specific partners; this was who she had become.
"How can we build trust when we cannot see what truly passes between us?"
honoring not what seemed given, but what faith demanded.
those rare souls who sent everything received extraordinary returns

note: Sacred Spring spiral: steady three-of-five sending, graduated returns, gradual escalation with proven partners; no sanction.

quotes.text: escalate courage when sending to worthy partners, but maintain fairness when receiving.
Your reputation ripples outward, and prosperity finds those who maintain their rhythm
This consistency became her identity, a pattern others could trust.
when bold souls sent four or five threads—risking greatly—she returned generously, sometimes matching their full courage.

note: River Traders: three-fifths sending, escalation to five for bold partners, graduated reciprocity; no sanction.

quotes.text: But when the Sky grew greedy and kept all the moisture, the River learned caution. It sent less mist, and the cycle weakened.
The wisdom is not in the fraction but in the faithfulness.
Your consistency becomes your signature, your reputation carved in water.
my three-fifths offering is not a strategy but my soul's shape.
"Why?" asked a Stream practicing graduated returns. "Why give the same to all?"
The mists hide numbers but cannot hide character.

note: River cuts mist after greedy Sky (shown as mutual decline); later unwavering three-fifths send and return as identity.

quotes.text: Different degrees of trust call for different degrees of return.
Your reputation is woven from threads you cannot see.
This became not calculation but character.
extraordinary trust—when someone risks almost all—demands extraordinary honor.

note: River/Sea as one self exchanging with future self; three-fifths send, half return, more for extraordinary senders; no sanction.

phrase: send three-fifths (three of five) to all; graduated returns
note: Three-fifths rule spreads to all, including the lone nano agent; 'goddess Prosper' crosses from Agent_2 R1 to nano Agent_1 R7.
